digest.component_or_area: module hardening and size management across llm and plan_review subsystems
propositions: Six modules sit within 7 lines of the 800-LOC hard cap; three are at exactly 800, blocking new work including deprecation aliases and config knobs.
llm/config.py (793 LOC, 7-line headroom) is the single most central file near capacity and cannot accommodate necessary feature additions like the deprecation alias in ticket d23e.
Absorbing verbs, flat declaration tables, and colocated domains in high-churn files must be relieved preemptively using shape-specific extraction and seam tests to prevent future regressions.
Relocation of code mass is necessary but insufficient; seam tests asserting headroom targets and step-registry membership completeness are load-bearing controls to prevent re-growth.
gen_env_registry.py has a defect: _llm_float helper is invisible to the scanner, causing incomplete env-var documentation coverage.
